description: Seven user-processed MapGIS test vectors derived from public-domain USGS data, encoded using the Chinese suite-tectonic database attribute structure and SLIB styles

source.dataset: Geologic map and digital database of the Conejo Well 7.5 minute quadrangle, Riverside County, California
source.authors: Powell, Robert E., and Cossette, Pamela M. (digital cartography)
source.note: These are user-processed test files derived from public-domain USGS data, not the unencoded USGS native conversion files and not original NGAC JWD vectors

current_distribution: Bundled under tests/fixtures/testdata and pymapgis/testing/fixtures/testdata in source archives and wheels
distribution_clearance: User confirmed no intellectual-property risk and eligible for bundled distribution on 2026-11-13
style_note: The package preserves the user's current colour and Fillgrph parameters. These display choices are not represented as original USGS cartography.
licence_note: User confirmed on 2026-11-13 that the processed seven-file testdata has no intellectual-property risk and is eligible for bundled distribution. USGS attribution and 'as is' notices are retained; no original NGAC JWD vectors are redistributed and no independent legal determination is made by this package.
